mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.post_id AS postId, c.user_id AS userId, u.name, c.content, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM comments c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (comment_id, post_id, user_id, content) VALUES (comment_seq.NEXTVAL, #{postId}, #{userId}, #{content})
